subject: Your dog's meal plan in 2 minutes flat
preview_text: Stop spending 20 minutes guessing portions. One tap in the app does it all.
body_paragraphs: You know that panicky feeling when you're scooping kibble and wondering if this is too much or too little? I used to stand over the bowl for five minutes, second-guessing every scoop. Then I'd spend another 15 minutes googling 'how many calories in a chicken breast for a lab.'

I built this app because I was tired of wasting my evenings on math problems. Turns out, your dog doesn't need a spreadsheet—they just need the right numbers, fast. That's why the custom meal plan takes two taps and ten seconds to generate.

Open the app, tap 'Meal Plan,' and it's done. Based on your dog's breed, age, and current weight, it calculates the perfect portions for every meal and treat. No more guesswork, no more 'is this healthy?' anxiety. Just two minutes saved every single day.

Try it right now: open PupShape, tap 'Meal Plan,' and see what your dog's ideal portion looks like. P.S. If you're still scooping by eye, you're probably overfeeding by 20 percent—let the app fix that in one click.
cta_text: Open PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan
